description: This file defines the 'Language' class within the Opencart Admin Controller Startup namespace. It manages the initialization and setup of language settings in the admin area of OpenCart, including loading language files, setting default language configurations, and handling language-specific extensions.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing language settings in the OpenCart admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load available languages, determine the active language based on configuration and cookies, and set the language context accordingly.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Post-processing hook to fill language data with default values if necessary, and load language files for specific routes, extension, or default language.
